content: Nothing is impossible when you believe in yourself.
note: 只要相信你自己，就没有什么不可能。
translation: 投稿人的话：I want to say: I am freshman, and encounter so many things. My friends and my classmates help me, understand me. Thank you these guys about learning oral English. I make a promise, I will go for it!
caption: 词霸每日一句
